Stealth!! Infiltrate the Energy Plant (Japanese: ギチギチ！！地下プラント潜入 Creak!! Infiltrate the Underground Plant) is the 17th chapter of the of the Pokémon Adventures manga.

==Plot==
 
 

==Major events==
Bede, Sonia, Leon, and Raihan investigate the explosion in Hammerlocke.
Rose explains to Raihan that he is trying to experiment with Wishing Stars to prevent an energy crisis a thousand years away.
After Raihan leaves, Rose prepares to feed the Wishing Stars to .
earns the .
A Dynamaxed starts rampaging in the Route 9 Tunnel.
